page.layout: One page of text in one column; a few marginal marks on the right margin (pencil-like scribbles, not printed text) are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Κύρ, juvenis, inter puerum virumque medius : qui, ut plurimùm, ferociores & petulantiores esse solent : ceoil, olim, (nunc churle :) duri agrestisque viringenii : sed & rusticus.
Κυείλιος, & ... apud Homerum, de marito & uxore, qui juvenes. Saxonicè, ceozlian, ... Matth. XXII. verf. 30. ne big ne ceozlsatb on tham arrise : neque nuptum dentur in resurrectione.
Κόρη, & κάρη, filia, puella ; a gyrle.
Κόννος, menti barba, apud Lucianum. Anglis, chin, mentum.
Κοσμὸς, ornatus nimius, affectata corporis elegantia ; comely, nitidus, elegans.
Κυίζιν, κυίνδαν (verbum Tarentinum, de quo Scal.in Virgilii Catal.) prurire, to itch.
Κῆδος, affinitas ex nuptiis contracta : κηδεστής, affinis, socer, gener : κηδεύω, affinitatem contraho, &c. Angl. kinred, affinitas, propinquitas. Si quis tamen malit ex γνώ, συγγενής, συγγένεια.

page.notes: Greek words are only approximated in this transcription; the scan is faint and several Greek and black-letter words are uncertain. Marginal pencil marks on the right were not transcribed.
